templates.name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
templates.description: Standard Terms for a mutual NDA allowing both parties to share confidential information for a defined purpose, with obligations on use, protection, and return of that information.

templates.name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement Cover Page
templates.description: Cover Page for the Mutual NDA where the parties fill in the purpose, effective date, term, governing law, jurisdiction, and signatures; it incorporates the Mutual NDA Standard Terms.

templates.name: Cloud Service Agreement
templates.description: Standard Terms for selling and buying cloud software (SaaS), covering access and use, restrictions, fees, confidentiality, warranties, liability, indemnification, and term.

templates.name: Software License Agreement
templates.description: Standard Terms for licensing installable or on-premise software to a customer, covering the license grant, restrictions, support, fees, warranties, liability, and term.

templates.name: Service Level Agreement
templates.description: Standard Terms that add uptime targets, response time commitments, and service credits to a cloud service agreement.

templates.name: Data Processing Agreement
templates.description: Standard Terms governing how a provider processes customer personal data, addressing GDPR and other privacy laws, subprocessors, security, and international data transfers.

templates.name: Business Associate Agreement
templates.description: Standard Terms for HIPAA compliance that set out how a provider (business associate) may use, disclose, and safeguard protected health information (PHI).

templates.name: AI Addendum
templates.description: Addendum to a product agreement covering the customer's use of AI services, including input, output, model training restrictions, and related responsibilities.

templates.name: Professional Services Agreement
templates.description: Standard Terms for engaging a provider to perform professional services under statements of work (SOWs), covering deliverables, fees, IP, confidentiality, and liability.

templates.name: Design Partner Agreement
templates.description: Standard Terms for giving an early design partner access to a pre-release product in exchange for feedback, with confidentiality and IP ownership terms.

templates.name: Pilot Agreement
templates.description: Standard Terms for a limited-time pilot or trial that lets a customer evaluate a product before purchasing, covering access, restrictions, and term.

templates.name: Partnership Agreement
templates.description: Standard Terms for business partnerships where each party performs agreed obligations, covering payments, trademark licensing, privacy, escalation, and confidentiality.
